shortDescription:
Mr. Amit Gupta holds a Master of Computer Applications (MCA) and is an accomplished IT professional with over 17 years of experience in Information Technology, SAP, Enterprise Applications and Digital Transformation. He has worked with leading organizations including UFlex, Kaane Packaging, Paharpur 3P and KG Flexx, managing technology initiatives across manufacturing and business environments.

Mr. Gupta focuses on aligning technology with business objectives, improving operational efficiency and enabling scalable digital solutions. His leadership experience covers IT strategy, project and programme management, vendor management, cybersecurity and digital transformation, with a strong emphasis on business value, governance and sustainable technology growth.
biography: Currently serving as the Head – Information Technology at Product Armor, Amit is responsible for driving the organization's digital transformation roadmap, strengthening IT governance, enhancing cybersecurity, modernizing enterprise infrastructure, and delivering innovative technology solutions that improve business performance. He works closely with leadership teams to ensure technology acts as a strategic business enabler rather than just a support function.
